2.198.14
RadialScale.MinimumPin
Applies to RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
The RadialScale.MinimumPin element specifies the minimum value at which a RadialPointer on a
RadialScale will stop. This element is optional. This element is of type ScalePin.
The following is the parent element of the RadialScale.MinimumPin element.
Parent elements
RadialScale
The following is the XML Schema definition of the RadialScale.MinimumPin element.
 <xsd:element name="MinimumPin" type="ScalePinType" minOccurs="0" />
